verdict.rationale: cubic generates AI suggestions from the user's code and PR data inside its own PR UI: review comments on bugs and improvements, AI chat answering questions about a PR using the codebase, AI-generated PR summaries and diagrams, and AI wikis. The 'insights' half is thinner, because the analytics dashboard reports metrics rather than documented AI-generated insights, and the AI chat docs sit in an archive section. missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights over analytics or team data, current (non-archived) docs for in-product AI chat, stronger independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Comments on bugs and improvements in pull requests
AI chat answers questions about a pull request while you read it. It reads the PR and the rest of your codebase.
Visualize complex systems with AI-generated diagrams.
cubic's AI wiki automatically indexes your codebase and produces searchable wikis, complete with links to source code, architecture diagrams, and more.
